announcement.quote: NHS Shareholders and NOX Stockholders are not entitled to demand the fair value of their shares on a reorganization; therefore, NHS Shareholders and NOX Stockholders will be bound by the terms of the Agreement, if it is approved.

deals.notes: The excerpts describe a Reorganization in which NHS shareholders and NOX stockholders would receive shares of 'New NHS Stock'. The DEF 14A of 2011-06-08 (joint annual meeting of NHS and NRO) is about electing directors and does not mention the reorganization outcome. 'New NHS' is the term used in the text; the target CIK given is the episode CIK per the filing header (Neuberger Berman High Yield Strategies Fund Inc.).

deals.notes: Text says NHS and NOX common stock may be sold 'on the NYSE or NYSE Amex, as applicable', but whether New NHS is itself listed is not stated, so both_listed is null. Ticker NOX is taken from the abbreviation in the text, not printed as an exchange ticker.

problems: Outcome not stated in any excerpt. The exact structure (which fund survives, what New NHS is) is not clear from the excerpts. Full names of NOX not in the excerpts.
